summary: Add typed continuity and streaming JSONL events

delivery.outcome: Long-running agents can publish bounded, typed continuity metadata and deterministically verify recovery, splits and Git slice causality without storing raw session content.
nonGoals: No raw prompt, tool stdout/stderr, command, patch, diff, secret or host path
No local session transcript storage format
No append runtime or execution authority
No rewrite of v0.4 contract, Protobuf or existing event evidence

architecture.decision: Add an optional closed continuity payload to the v1 event projection, require it for ten declared namespaced event types, mirror the variants as a Protobuf oneof and validate causal pair digests during replay.
interfaceChanges: Ten continuity event type names and closed JSON payload variants
ContinuityPayload Protobuf oneof and ten variant messages
Causal pair validation for resume, tool, split and Git publication
dataChanges: Continuity payload participates in canonical event hashing when present
architecture.rollback: Stop emitting v0.5 continuity events and select the preserved v0.4 contract/root; existing v0.1-v0.4 streams remain unchanged.

validation.evidence: The ten-event fixture conforms to the closed contract.
Causal and digest mismatch cases fail deterministically.
Forbidden content fields fail the closed payload contract.

commands: docker run --rm --network none --read-only --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --tmpfs /root/.cache:rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,size=16m -v $PWD:/workspace:ro -w /workspace bufbuild/buf:1.57.2@sha256:60dea959d4a9ea381a2c9d6f8760678845234e086f632ec01a64bb588143a226 lint
validation.evidence: Host, container, Buf and exact governance checks pass.
